messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some fun true or false questions for introducing a new teacher to your students 先生

Here are some ideas you can customize based on the teacher and their personality and interests 趣味

1. The teacher has never eaten pizza in their entire life before they became a teacher 先生
2. The teacher can speak three languages fluently and has traveled to more than ten countries 国
3. The teacher once performed on stage in front of a large audience as a child 子供
4. The teacher is afraid of small enclosed spaces and has never gone through a tunnel 怖い
5. The teacher once met a famous celebrity at a public event and took a photo 写真
6. The teacher has never watched a full movie in one sitting without falling asleep first 映画
7. The teacher can play an instrument they learned before age ten and still practice weekly 音楽
8. The teacher has a pet that most people would not expect to see in a 動物

Tips: Mix obviously false statements with surprising truths to keep energy high and students engaged throughout 活動 the activity Let students vote and discuss before revealing answers to build curiosity and foster new 友情
